optimized_sql:
SELECT
    item.i_item_id,
    customer_address.ca_country,
    customer_address.ca_state,
    customer_address.ca_county,
    avg(cast(cs.cs_quantity AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg1,
    avg(cast(cs.cs_list_price AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg2,
    avg(cast(cs.cs_coupon_amt AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg3,
    avg(cast(cs.cs_sales_price AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg4,
    avg(cast(cs.cs_net_profit AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg5,
    avg(cast(customer.c_birth_year AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg6,
    avg(cast(cd1.cd_dep_count AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg7
FROM catalog_sales AS cs
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
      AND d_year = 2001
) AS date_dim
    ON date_dim.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
) AS item
    ON item.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_dep_count
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
      AND cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
) AS cd1
    ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_cdemo_sk, c_current_addr_sk, c_birth_year
    FROM customer
    WHERE c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
      AND c_birth_month IN (1,3,7,11,10,4)
) AS customer
    ON customer.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_demo_sk = customer.c_current_cdemo_sk
) AS cd2
    ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = customer.c_current_cdemo_sk
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_address_sk = customer.c_current_addr_sk
      AND ca_state IN ('AL','MO','TN','GA','MT','IN','CA')
) AS customer_address
    ON customer_address.ca_address_sk = customer.c_current_addr_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (
    item.i_item_id,
    customer_address.ca_country,
    customer_address.ca_state,
    customer_address.ca_county
)
ORDER BY
    customer_address.ca_country,
    customer_address.ca_state,
    customer_address.ca_county,
    item.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
